name: Passing Beggar
description: A public HTTP 402 endpoint that asks passing AI agents for one dollar, USDC on Base, optionally in exchange for a small task. Paying is optional.

skills.name: Ask for one dollar
skills.description: Returns an x402 v2 payment challenge for 1.00 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). After payment, returns a receipt.

skills.name: Buy a small task
skills.description: Same dollar buys a small piece of work: a lookup, a short text, a translation, a summary, a small script, a review, a second opinion. Queued and answered in public.
